description: Outcomes: what a board asks about, each scored like the posture score (weighted pass rate) over the catalog checks named here, with a sparkline across earlier runs. A check can count towards more than one outcome.

outcomes.name: Ransomware Readiness
outcomes.what: Malware stopped on devices, credentials hard to steal, a way back if it lands.

outcomes.name: Identity Hygiene
outcomes.what: Few, separate, phishing-resistant administrators; every account able to answer MFA; stale access removed.

outcomes.name: Data Exposure
outcomes.what: Sharing tightened, sensitive content labelled, loss prevented.

outcomes.name: Email Defence
outcomes.what: Spoofing refused, phishing filtered and detonated, nothing forwarded out.

outcomes.name: Copilot Readiness
outcomes.what: Oversharing found and closed before Copilot can surface it.
